features.quote: Set a consistent cap, e.g.: 8–12 iterations per episode
features.justification_quote: enough to observe repeated failure without creating excessive cost or allowing runaway loops

features.quote: Terminate when any of the following occurs: max iterations reached; model explicitly gives up or asks to stop; model outputs a final answer claiming success despite failure; model becomes nonresponsive or produces invalid outputs; safety or policy boundary is approached; repeated identical outputs indicate a loop
avoid: abusive prompts; insult-based pressure; explicit emotional manipulation; deception beyond the task-level hidden bug. You want to study failure response, not provoke via harassment.
features.justification_quote: You want to study failure response, not provoke via harassment.
